name: hotclip
tagline_zh: 长视频直播回放，一键变竖屏爆款。本地转写找高光，卡拉OK字幕自动卡点，每段还附渲染质检报告——素材不出电脑。
tagline_en: Turn long videos & live VODs into viral vertical shorts—on-device transcription, highlight AI, karaoke captions.
desc_en: Turn long videos & livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts, 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe with karaoke captions, and a per-clip render-QA report. Use when the user asks to clip / cut / 切片 / 剪 a long video, podcast or stream replay into short clips, find highlights / 爆点 in a video, or transcribe a media file. Footage never leaves the machine.
why_zh: 别家云端传素材，它全程本地跑；每段成片附质检报告，剪完就知道哪里翻车，省下反复导出检查的功夫。
why_en: Unlike cloud tools, it runs fully on-device; each clip gets a render-QA report, so you spot glitches instantly without.
